name: Hammerfest LNG (Snohvit), Norway (Equinor) - all-electric liquefaction
description: world-scale LNG plant in which, for the first time, all main refrigeration compressors are electrically driven; Equinor investing about USD 1.3 bn to grid-connect and further electrify the plant

sources.note: Offshore Energy (all main compressors electrically driven - a first for world-scale LNG); highnorthnews 22 Dec 2022 (USD 1.3 bn electrification investment); read 2026-10-28
